question: Name the world famous scientist known for his theory of relativity.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Albert Einstein.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Albert Einstein gave the theory of relativity.__
 
• Albert Einstein established a relation between mass and energy on the basis of the special theory called the Theory of relativity in 1905.
 
• According to this theory, mass can be converted into energy and vice-versa.
 __
 
• i.e., E = mc2
 
 
 
• Where,
 
 
• c is the velocity of light.
 
• E is the energy equivalent of mass m.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Christian Bernard **had performed the world’s first heart transplant.

 
 
• He performed the first human-to-human heart transplant operation on 3 December 1967.
 
 
 
• **Thomas Alva Edison **discovered the electric lamp. Edison was an American Scientist.
 
• **John Dalton** first proposed an atomic theory of matter and he named it Dalton's atomic theory.
 
 
• Dalton’s atomic theory was able to explain the law of conservation of mass, law of constant composition and law of multiple proportions very successfully.
